scripts.start: concurrently "npm start --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm start --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.check: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm test --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.audit:prod: npm audit --omit=dev --prefix backend && npm audit --omit=dev --prefix frontend
